props.description: True to open the picture full size in the Lightbox on a press; needs `src` and `alt`.
props.name: isZoomable

props.description: The image URL; the fallback icon shows while it is missing or after it fails to load.
props.name: src

props.description: The icon drawn with no image or a broken one. Defaults to the image icon, or the broken-image icon after an error.
props.name: fallback

props.description: The accessible name; without it the thumbnail is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
props.name: alt

props.description: A tiny image (a few pixels wide) drawn blurred until `src` loads, then faded out.
props.name: placeholderSrc

props.description: `cover` crops to fill the box, `contain` letterboxes the whole image. Defaults to `cover`.
props.name: fit
